$Comment: What the members of the Yeti's fight see as he rises and the fight begins: a big banner, his line
and, under it, what the fight is for. Its binding row points its Engaged beat here
(ZiggfreedCommon/Encounters/Christmas_Yeti_Encounter.json, Feedback.Engaged). Keys are lines in this
The moment fires once per member. The banner always reaches the members (ToParticipants) and anyone
else standing within RadiusBlocks of them, which keeps it inside this one cave: the caves of one copy
share a world but stand far further apart than this. MinSecondsBetween folds the members' fires into
one banner, and stays short so it never swallows another party's banner in the same copy.
